title: Testing and Best Practices
description: Learn testing strategies and best practices for TypeScript in React.
longDescription: The final module focuses on testing TypeScript React applications and best practices for maintaining type safety. You'll learn to write typed tests, use type narrowing in components, apply advanced type safety patterns, and migrate existing JavaScript codebases to TypeScript incrementally. The capstone lesson covers mocking components and utilities with proper typing, ensuring your test suite is as robust as your production code.
whatYouLearn: Write typed tests for React components
